dataset_sample_notice: Dataset Notice: Trained on a sample of UK-DALE (5 houses) and IAWE (1 house, 2 synthetic channel splits). Results reflect sample demonstration scale.
house_count_breakdown: 6 physical households (5 UK-DALE + 1 IAWE) split into 7 GroupKFold evaluation clusters via 1 synthetic channel split (IAWE_house_1 / IAWE_house_2).
iawe_house_split_note: IAWE_house_1 and IAWE_house_2 represent a synthetic split of IAWE dataset channels for GroupKFold cross-validation, not distinct physical households.
ac_hvac_sample_limitation_note: AC/HVAC positive readings (310 samples) originate entirely from IAWE channels (IAWE_house_1 and IAWE_house_2). All UK-DALE houses (UKDALE_house_1 to UKDALE_house_5) contain 0 positive AC samples.
